name: runtime_rooted
description: One row per root advance with the post-apply cache invariants

bank_seq.description: Monotonic sequence number identifying this block within the current run; the join key to runtime_block. Restarts at 1 each time a snapshot is loaded, so pair it with the stream's boot id. 0 means unavailable.

slot.description: Slot of the newly rooted block

epoch.description: Epoch the rooted slot belongs to

stake_delegations_upserts.description: Number of stake-delegations delta entries (non-tombstone) applied into the root map by this root advance. The advance covers every bank on (prev_root_slot, slot]. Each bank keeps at most one delta entry per stake account (last update wins), so this can be lower than the count of runtime_stake_delegation rows with kind upsert or reward whose slot is in that range when one account is mutated multiple times in a block.

stake_delegations_removes.description: Number of stake-delegations tombstone delta entries applied by this root advance, counted per account per bank (tombstones for accounts absent from the root map still count); matches the count of runtime_stake_delegation rows with kind remove whose slot is in (prev_root_slot, slot] except when one account is removed more than once in a block.

stake_delegations_cnt.description: Total entries in the root stake-delegations cache after this advance

effective_stake.description: Root stake-delegations effective-stake total after this advance

activating_stake.description: Root stake-delegations activating-stake total after this advance

deactivating_stake.description: Root stake-delegations deactivating-stake total after this advance

block_id.description: Block id (final FEC merkle root) of the newly rooted block
